review.head: cea276d0ee1d7b27d22ee0ba161a1f6ff4310b97
review.notes: Full review. Gate: build check fails only on Lake's `module` warning (toolchain v4.35.0-rc3); `lake env lean` gives 133 sorry warnings and no error; a probe with `module` prepended elaborates clean; depcheck 0 problems (but the README writes `*Prerequisites:*`, not `*Needs:*`, so the mechanical edges were resolved by hand). Seeded sample verified at the text: BCM Def 1.1, Thm 1.2, 1.3, Ass 1.4, Cor 1.7, Thm 2.5, Prop 2.6, Lemma 2.7, Prop 3.1, Thm 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, 4.2; RRV sections 2, 5, 9, 10 (10.1), 11 (11.1), 12 (12.2), 13 (13.1), (13.2); Qian Lemma 3.4; Negami 7.2.1 (BH 4.5, 4.7, 4.8); Greene Def 2.4, 3.10, Thm 3.6, 3.13; Fedorov Thm 1; Ono Thm 1. Beukers-Heckman itself paywalled (GDZ landing page only): BH Thm 4.3 (3.5) and Thm 5.8 (3.9) not verifiable. Suppliers resolved on main (ClassicalArithmeticCompletion 2.46, 2.60, 7.12, 7.29; LFunctions Layer 0; ThetaSeries 2H; ModularCurves 4C), under Completed (Chebotarev Layer 4, HodgeStructures, NumberFieldArithmetic, PolynomialGaloisGroups) and at open heads (CharacterSumsOverFiniteFields 3.4, EllipticLegendreCharacterInterfaces 0.1 and 5.1, DeligneWeightsAndPurity 0.1, MotivesAndAlgebraicCycles Layers 1-2). Pinned Mathlib and Tau Ceti declarations opened by file and line. Adversarial pass computed numerically: Gauss sums over F_5, F_7, F_11, F_13, the sums of Def 1.1 and of Thm 1.3, Ono's count, the degree-one datum, the shift and swap identities, Greene's 2F1, the zigzag on 2322 cyclotomic data, Landau's exponent, rotation numbers, the Bezout determinant for d = 10, tame ranks at p = 7. Two P1: the recorded heights of the zigzag collapse repeated parameters (refutes the roadmap's own Hodge vectors of A2.2_B1.1, A2.2.2.2_B1.1.1.1, A2.2_B4 and nine Lean theorems), and the shift identity fails at t = 0. Four P2: Hasse-Davenport product cited to a section that does not state it (ClassicalArithmeticCompletion 7.29 does), Ono's theorem statable at the pins but absent, f = 0 junk in frobeniusTrace_integral, missing good-prime hypothesis in frobeniusPolynomial_int_of_isPure.
